messages:
sara: Heads-up — PR #2764 blocked by the lint/typecheck gate in CI, failing on mypy + pre-commit. Anyone available to help triage?
ci-bot: CI job `lint_and_typechecks` failed on ubuntu-latest · exit code 1 · https://ci.redwood.internal/job/2764/123 :x: 
omar: Can you paste the failing output?
sara: sure — mypy part looks like this:
```
src/runtime/cache.py:42: error: Item "None" of "Optional[str]" has no attribute "strip"  [union-attr]
   40 |     def normalize_key(key: Optional[str]) -> str:
   41 |         # expect key to be str, but sometimes None sneaks in
>  42 |         return key.strip().lower()
       |                    ^^^^^
```
and pre-commit failed on rustfmt in the serving crate: `crates/serving/src/lib.rs` — diffing shows rustfmt changes required.
jamal: I think my cache-key refactor touched that function — sorry, will look. Can someone try a rerun? If it's flaky we might bisect.
dev-bot: Rerun requested by @jamal — enqueueing `lint_and_typechecks` (job 2764.124) :repeat:
omar: If you can't repro locally try `pre-commit run --all-files` and `mypy src/runtime --show-error-codes` — also ensure you have the pinned mypy/stubs from poetry.lock.
sara: I reproduced locally with the same mypy error. Quick fix is to guard for None: `if key is None: return ""` and then run `cargo fmt --all` to satisfy rustfmt. I'll open a follow-up patch to fix both. :thumbsup:
jamal: Thanks — once you push, I'll rerun the CI and if it still flakes I'll do a bisect across recent merges (start point ~1809872000). Ping @eng-infra if the rerun needs a fresh runner.
sara: pushed fix in the follow-up commit, requested CI rerun. I'll post back if anything else slips through.
